lines.ja: いつメンだった私たち、いつの間にか見える景色がバラバラになってしまった。
lines.en: We used to be an inseparable crew, but before we knew it, we started seeing entirely different worlds.
lines.speaker: Protagonist

lines.ja: 乳って飾りじゃないのよ。今なんてさ、授乳で眠れないんだから。
lines.en: Breasts aren't just for decoration, you know. Right now, I can't even sleep because of breastfeeding.
lines.speaker: Friend

lines.ja: 母親というネクストステージに進んだことを強調する、隠れマウントね。
lines.en: That subtle flex, emphasizing she has moved on to the next stage of being a mother.
lines.speaker: Protagonist

clips.title: Will You Give That Baby to Me?
grammar: 〜ちょうだい — give me / please do

lines.en: Are you going to keep it?
lines.speaker: Friend

lines.ja: その子供、私にちょうだい？
lines.en: Could you give that child to me?
lines.speaker: Friend
